description: As a compliance officer, I want the document upload feature to reject unsupported file types so that only valid document formats are stored in the system.

acs.text: The upload component accepts only PDF, DOCX, and XLSX files.
If an unsupported file type is selected, an error is shown immediately: 'Unsupported file type. Please upload PDF, DOCX, or XLSX only.'
The file is not uploaded or stored when rejected.
Maximum allowed file size is 10 MB. Files exceeding this limit are rejected with a separate error message.
